<style>
/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SAO GALLERY · Native Elementor Management v5.1
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   HOW TO EDIT:
   1. Use the 'Basic Gallery' widgets above in your Navigator.
   2. Add/Remove images via the standard Elementor sidebar.
   3. The marquee will automatically update.
   ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

:root {
  --sao-speed-1: 48s;
  --sao-speed-2: 54s;
  --sao-gap: 22px;
  --sao-h: 310px;
  --sao-h-tablet: 220px;
  --sao-h-mobile: 168px;
  --sao-radius: 20px;
  --sao-fade-w: 180px;
  --sao-bg: #F9F6F0;
  --sao-row-gap: 22px;
}

/* Container Fade Masks */
#sao-sect-v5, #sao-col-v5, #sao-col-v5 > .elementor-widget-wrap,
#sao-col-v5 > .elementor-column-wrap > .elementor-widget-wrap {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* The marquee container (Section/Column) */
#sao-col-v5 .elementor-widget-wrap::before,
#sao-col-v5 .elementor-widget-wrap::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: var(--sao-fade-w);
  z-index: 10;
  pointer-events: none;
}
#sao-col-v5 .elementor-widget-wrap::before {
  left: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--sao-bg) 0%, transparent 100%);
}
#sao-col-v5 .elementor-widget-wrap::after {
  right: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--sao-bg) 0%, transparent 100%);
}

/* Force Gallery into horizontal track */
.sao-marquee-row {
  margin-bottom: var(--sao-row-gap) !important;
}
.sao-marquee-row .elementor-image-gallery {
  display: flex !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
}
.sao-marquee-row .gallery {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
  gap: var(--sao-gap) !important;
  width: max-content !important;
  will-change: transform;
}

/* Direction-specific animations */
.sao-row--left  .gallery { animation: saoLeft  var(--sao-speed-1) linear infinite; }
.sao-row--right .gallery { animation: saoRight var(--sao-speed-2) linear infinite; }

/* Pause on hover */
.sao-marquee-row:hover .gallery { animation-play-state: paused; }

@keyframes saoLeft  {
  from { transform: translateX(0); }
  to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}
@keyframes saoRight {
  from { transform: translateX(-50%); }
  to   { transform: translateX(0); }
}

/* Image & Figure Styles */
.sao-marquee-row .gallery-item {
  margin: 0 !important;
  width: auto !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}
.sao-marquee-row .gallery-icon img {
  height: var(--sao-h) !important;
  width: auto !important;
  min-width: 180px;
  max-width: 520px;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: var(--sao-radius);
  display: block;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 28px rgba(26,20,16,0.09), 0 1px 4px rgba(26,20,16,0.05);
  transition: transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1),
              box-shadow 0.55s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.sao-marquee-row .gallery-icon img:hover {
  transform: scale(1.045) translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(26,20,16,0.16), 0 4px 12px rgba(26,20,16,0.08);
}

/* Responsive Adjustments */
@media (max-width:1024px) {
  :root {
    --sao-h: var(--sao-h-tablet);
    --sao-fade-w: 80px;
    --sao-gap: 16px;
    --sao-row-gap: 16px;
  }
}
@media (max-width:767px) {
  html, body { overflow-x: hidden !important; max-width: 100vw; }
  :root {
    --sao-h: var(--sao-h-mobile);
    --sao-fade-w: 48px;
    --sao-gap: 12px;
    --sao-row-gap: 12px;
    --sao-radius: 12px;
    --sao-speed-1: 32s;
    --sao-speed-2: 36s;
  }
  .sao-marquee-row .gallery-icon img:hover {
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 28px rgba(26,20,16,0.09);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .gallery { animation: none !important; }
}
</style>

<script>
/**
 * SAO Gallery — Native Loop Controller
 * Clones the gallery items once for seamless infinite scrolling.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  var initGalleryLoop = function() {
    var rows = document.querySelectorAll('.sao-marquee-row .gallery');
    rows.forEach(function (gallery) {
      if (!gallery || gallery.getAttribute('data-sao-looped')) return;
      
      // Clone all gallery items to create a seamless loop
      var items = gallery.querySelectorAll('.gallery-item');
      if (items.length === 0) return;

      items.forEach(function(item) {
        var clone = item.cloneNode(true);
        clone.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        gallery.appendChild(clone);
      });

      gallery.setAttribute('data-sao-looped', 'true');
    });
  };

  // Run on load and after potential Elementor frontend refreshes
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initGalleryLoop);
  
  // For Elementor Editor: Re-run when widgets are changed
  if (window.elementorFrontend) {
    elementorFrontend.hooks.addAction('frontend/element_ready/widget', function() {
      initGalleryLoop();
    });
  }
  
  // Immediate fallback run
  setTimeout(initGalleryLoop, 500);
})();
</script>
